anchor_definition: The anchor is the GET request wrapper A: its body generates rast = (new Date).getTime() and appends &rast=/?rast= to the URL before issuing the GET. PLAN §5.1: the function that actually constructs and attaches the value is the anchor — not the sibling POST helper (no rast), the login action that calls A, or store getters.

anchor.why: GET helper that, unless an override is provided, appends rast=(new Date).getTime().toString() to the URL and then calls o.a.get(t,...). This is where the observed rast query parameter is produced and attached.

roles.why: A sibling multipart POST helper in the same http module. It issues a request but never adds rast; tempting but wrong.
An unrelated Vuex getter returning the user id; not on the request path.
